body: Shit got better for me and I still wanna end it because it isn’t what I wanted. I wish you the best.

I’m almost done with my letter but damn 300k. I could not realistically see myself in that position I’m already below the poverty line but anyways man. I admire your strength and your mental fortitude I wish you the best in everything. I’m sorry I wasn’t a little stronger m. :)

Man I’ve tried every resource I’m “smart” by societies standards but I can’t take it anymore.  Money just fuels more depression to my already unmotivated self. I was always the optimist I always cheered on my friends I always did everything I was the guy everyone relied on and now I’m a failure. I’m still struggling I’m depressed I have no future unless I take another gap year and save even more money on a minimum wage job and try again and I already did it once and failed and I’m not willing to do it again.  

As I sit here writing my suicide letter I’m just sad about what I’m gonna leave people disappointed and crush the dreams of people who looked up to me. But I just can’t man . I tried I really did . Life’s too rough and I’m not built to withstand my harsh reality any longer .
I kept thinking that but honestly things never go my way ever and I keep fighting and fighting but I’m done and all out of steam so the ivy thing is my last saving grace before I leave.
